components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single filled account action, berry gradient with a warm inner highlight.

components.css: .ds-transport { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; } .ds-bars { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; } .ds-bar { width: 44px; height: 24px; padding: 0; display: grid; align-items: center; border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; transition: width 0.55s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-bar span { display: block; width: 100%; height: 3px; border-radius: 3px; background: rgba(74, 20, 32, 0.38); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(96, 22, 42, 0.16); transition: background 0.3s; } .ds-bar:hover span { background: rgba(74, 20, 32, 0.58); } .ds-bar.is-active { width: 64px; } .ds-bar.is-active span { background: #4a1420; } .ds-bar:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d8415e; outline-offset: -2px; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-auto { width: 26px; height: 26px; display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 0; border: 1px solid rgba(74, 20, 32, 0.28); border-radius: 50%; background: transparent; color: #4a1420; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.3s, border-color 0.3s, transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-auto:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.36); border-color: rgba(74, 20, 32, 0.5); transform: scale(1.06); } .ds-auto:active { transform: scale(0.94); } .ds-auto.is-paused { background: rgba(74, 20, 32, 0.88); border-color: transparent; color: #fff4f6; }

narrative.overview:
A warm cream page holds one saturated pink stage. The illustration is the only sharp, saturated object on it; everything else is soft paper, wine-colored type, and quiet pink controls. The world is intimate and small on purpose: three works, one character, one author, a collection that feels pinned to a desk rather than loaded from a database.

The interface behaves like gallery furniture: a mark, a navigation line, two account actions, pagination bars with an autoplay switch, arrows placed outside the frame. Inside the stage the hero is layered — pale orbs, a 45%-soft-light grain, drifting petals, a cursor-following spot, and a print that lifts off the rose. State motion is slow and buoyant (0.25–1s on one easing curve); parallax uses a second, softer curve, and ambient drift runs at 8s. The 7.8s autoplay starts paused under reduced motion and can be stopped by hand. The system is one font family and a very small set of surface recipes; the richness comes from layering and warmth, not from added components.
keyCharacteristics: Cream paper with a blush top edge, fixed fine grain at 32% multiply, and no cool greys anywhere.
One rose stage with wine type; berry is reserved for the single filled account action.
Gabarito alone (400–900, self-hosted, swap), from display to footer.
Pill actions, rounded image mats, circles for arrows and closes; no square corners.
Soft plum shadows with large blur and negative spread; no hard offset shadows, almost no 1px outlines.
The hero print is provisional; .hero__art.is-framed is the documented swap point for transparent cutouts.

rules.name: The Wine-On-Rose Rule
rules.body: Type on rose is always Wine Ink (#4a1420), never body ink or black. It holds 6.66:1 on the base rose and 5.76:1 on the deepest stop, so normal-size text passes AA anywhere on the stage.

rules.name: The One Filled Action Rule
rules.body: Berry appears once per viewport, on Criar conta. Secondary actions use the ghost outline or the pink wash; selected states use charcoal. If two berry filled buttons are visible, one is wrong.

rules.name: The Warm Neutral Rule
rules.body: No pure grey, no pure black, no cool white as a field. White is a material accent only: the 7px print mat (#fff8f3), the scene mat (#fffaf7), and the viewer shell (#fbf6f2).

rules.name: The Single Family Rule
rules.body: Gabarito is the only family. The Inter fallback is declared but never fetched; do not load it or add a second display face.

rules.name: The Tight Display Rule
rules.body: The negative tracking and 0.98 line-height belong to the hero title alone. Body copy keeps its default 1.5 and zero tracking.

rules.name: The Uppercase-Is-Metadata Rule
rules.body: Uppercase with letterspacing is reserved for metadata, state tags, and the footer. It never introduces a section.

rules.name: The Stage-Not-Card Rule
rules.body: The hero is the only full-color page field. Shelves sit directly on paper without their own page-level panels; each item carries its own mat or wash.

rules.name: The Warm Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are plum, never neutral black. Blur is large, spread is negative; a shadow that reads as a grey halo is off-world.

rules.name: The Lift-Not-Outline Rule
rules.body: Depth comes from shadow and a 1–2px translate. Standing outlines are hairlines on the ghost button (24% ink) and the viewer controls (12% ink); no card surface gains a border.

rules.name: The Pill-Or-Mat Rule
rules.body: If it is an action, it is a pill. If it is an image, it is a rounded mat with an inset image radius. Never a square interactive box.

rules.name: The Frame-Is-Provisional Rule
rules.body: The white print mat, cover crop, and −2.2° rotation exist only under .hero__art.is-framed. When transparent cutouts arrive, remove is-framed; the base image is object-fit contain, anchored bottom center, with no border. Do not delete the framed styles until the cutouts have been approved.

dos: Do keep the artwork the most saturated object on screen; chrome stays quiet and occupies well under a tenth of the surface.
Do set any type on rose in Wine Ink (#4a1420), at the shipped sizes and weights.
Do use Gabarito alone; make hierarchy with 400–900 weight, size, and the two tracking extremes.
Do use 999px pills for word actions and 16–34px radii for image mats; keep the mat/image nesting (5px mat, 16px inner image).
Do shade with warm plum, large blur, negative spread (rgba(96, 42, 54, …)).
Do treat .hero__art.is-framed as the swap point: test the hero both with the print mat and with a transparent cutout bleeding out of the rose.
Do keep metadata labels uppercase, 11–12px, with 0.08em+ tracking.
donts: Don't load or introduce a second display family; Inter stays an unused fallback.
Don't put body ink (#251b1e) or black on the rose; that role is Wine Ink only.
Don't add a decorative kicker or eyebrow above headings; uppercase is for metadata, state tags, and the footer only.

Don't use hard offset shadows, neutral grey shadows, or outline cards and images with rigid 1px borders; lift with diffuse warm shadow and 1–4px translation. Hairline borders belong only to the ghost button and viewer controls.
Don't use berry as a section fill or for more than one filled action per viewport.
Don't let arrows or pagination bars cover the framed print; use the shipped shrink/hide breakpoints.
Don't overlay interface labels on the artwork beyond the desktop 'toque na arte' hint and the state tags.
